crossRefs.note: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

translations.web: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
translations.bsb: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
translations.kjv: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
translations.asv: So shall I observe thy law continually For ever and ever.
